entries.name: Sipeed Maixduino 2832 V1.5
entries.description: Rear silkscreen-side view with USB-C and DC jack at the bottom, matching the official pin-assignment drawing. V1.5 P6.2 is NC even though the older drawing prints 3V3 there. Camera/LCD FPCs and microSD are illustrated as fitted cable/card ports; their fine contacts are outside the jumper-wire scope. GPIO1 contains 3.0 V and 1.8 V domains; the latter are explicitly marked per contact. RK3399 is on the reverse side, so the illustrated component face shows the two RAM packages. Camera/eMMC sockets are outside the wiring scope. All listed connector contacts are available. The component-side drawing places contacts on their corresponding physical pads/connectors. High-speed sockets, test points and configuration straps outside the declared scope are illustrated only. Mechanical offsets are reference geometry unless a manufacturer dimension drawing is explicitly identified.

discrepancies.details: GPIO1 contact10 wiki GPIOG3_A6 typo corrected to GPIO3_A6 from RK3328 schematic. USB-C v1.1/2009 selected; unchanged schematic sheets retain1912 footers.
CON6 contact1 is5 V and contact2 is3.3 V. Digital I/O and console are3.0 V. This10-contact header is not a Raspberry Pi pinout.
CON9 FPC3.3 V vs CON11 SDIO/I2S1.8 V; source-DXF alternating FPC solder-tail geometry retained. 2204 board, not LTS2308.
GPIO1 mixes3.0/1.8 V digital domains. MIC1 negative differential contact is not ground. RK3399 is on reverse; front picture shows two RAM packages.
Current M5 is RK3576/30 GPIO contacts. LPDDR4X2411 schematic selected. No Amlogic40-pin map substituted.
Web ON1-P39 typo means CON1.39 ground. Exact DXF confirms GPIO1 inner row; console GND1 is bottom and TX3 top.

Web repeats CON2 for console; v1.0 schematic identifies CON1 console and CON2 GPIO. Manufacturer top DXF is180 degrees rotated relative to maker overview; transformed to the same front view. Fan CN2 excluded because fitted position is not confirmed on source photograph.

v2.0 schematic overrides web table: pin15 PI11 (not PH11); pin22 PC2_3V3 and pin36 PC7_3V3 are level-shifted GPIO (not3.3 V supply rails). Pin28 TWI1_SCL rather than website TE1_SLC. Debug is horizontal GND/RX/TX. CN8 FPC24 includes PHY/USB/analog/power, not24 camera GPIOs.

Exact v1.1 schematic console has FOUR contacts including3.3 V, despite three-wire examples. Source DXF verifies main GPIO starts x30.5435mm, GND1 console top at x1.524mm, fan3 vertical, switched power4 reversed left-to-right. Fan defaults5 V;12 V resistor alternative is unpopulated.
v1.1 source DXF confirms GPIO pin1 inner column, console on lower LEFT edge, horizontal reverse fan and reversed vertical power4. Console has THREE contacts. Later2.5G/8GB editions not substituted.
v1.51 exact schematic/placement used; public maker overview photo v1.4 has matching connector arrangement. Original Amlogic ZERO, not ZERO2/3.
GPIO3_C0 pin32 is3.3 V, most GPIO3.0 V, ADC_IN0 pin26 max1.8 V. Reverse-side SoC/RTC not invented on front. Shared ROCK4B STEP is not exact4SE CAD.

Exact v2.10 assembly placement supersedes old v1.1 overview photo. GPIO on long right edge in portrait view. Fan1 is switched low-side return;2+5 V. Grounded shell tabs3/4 excluded as non-cable contacts. Pin37 analog divider input, not GPIO.

Exact v1.24 schematic overrides older v1.2 web table at27/28: GPIO4_C6 via fitted R95157 and GPIO4_C5 via R95159, rather than GPIO2_B3/GPIO2_B2. Optional USB links NC. Standard v1.24 used, not industrial2.01. No exact1.24 STEP verified; published STEP is1.2.
U23 fan1 is low-side switched return,2+5 V; grounded mounting tabs3/4 excluded from cable contacts. Rear RTC pads excluded from front scope.

maixWireless.scope: Selected verified Maix and LILYGO wireless board batch, not a claim that all manufacturer products are included.
limitations: All footprints are explicitly approximate off-board 2.54 mm cable-termination carriers, not board-mating land patterns.

Individually enumerated wiring scope is stated per entry. Fitted USB/RF/SD/SIM/camera/display cable ports are illustrated, but their fine cable/card contacts are not all separate jumper-wire contacts.

T3-S3 V1.3 GPIO8/12 and SIM7000G GPIO25/26 orders differ between old schematics and exact official production pinout photos. Physical art follows those photos; unnumbered main headers use printed pad names as terminal numbers, with repeated grounds disambiguated.

T-Echo electrical SWD mapping is from the manufacturer schematic. Its SWD pad geometry is representative because no official numbered pad-layout drawing was found; the entry explicitly requests checking VDD/GND against the board before attaching a probe.
Maix Bit V2.0 user headers have 18 holes per side. Schematic row positions 10/11 are mounting-annulus nodes, not four extra jumper holes; only the 36 real header holes are included.

Maixduino V1.5 P6.2 is NC despite an older marketing drawing printing 3V3. MaixCAM Pro schematic assigns A15=SDA and A27=SCL, unlike swapped marketing captions. Exact schematic functions are documented.
Supreme V3.1 PN1.5 is ALDO1 with fitted R24=0 ohm / R25=NC; the older marketing drawing calls it ALDO2. Programmable PMIC rail voltages are not presented as fixed 3.3 V.

T-Beam and T3 LoRa32 model links are clearly labeled manufacturer schematic references because no verified exact-revision STEP/mechanical file was found. Other links lead to verified manufacturer CAD/drawing files or folders.
